posts.cooked:
Well, it didn't happen sooner than Thanksgiving weekend, and the friends who were going to join us had to bail. So, the Grasshopper & I played a 2-player, 4-hero game. Granted that I chose my heroes to make easy to keep track of, and that the Grasshopper insisted on playing in Freedom Tower (even though we'd just used it for our warm-up game against Ambuscade, since neither of us had played since September), but we should have played Advanced Mode. Knyfe, GI Bunker, Wraith, and DW Expatriette just tore through the Baron. We had him flipped during Bunker's turn on round 2, I think (otherwise round 3), having taken 1 damage from him and needing to destroy a total of 3 cards. Two of those were easily expendible, and we continued to tear through him with ease.

Unfortunately, the game store was pretty lightly trafficked with people that we knew, so we couldn't get a picture taken. :(  Still, we'll have the envelope in the mail later this week.
